'''CRC-09/571''', or simply '''Seven-One''', was a [[clone battalion commander]] and later [[clone regimental commander]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Seven-One served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] within the [[airborne infantry]] as a [[battalion]] [[commander]] leading his [[Seven-One's airborne group|group]] against [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|core ships]]. Seven-One subsequently continued serving as a clone battalion commander in the [[Battle of Teyr]] under the [[416th Star Corps]] and then promoted to clone regimental commander for the [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|Battle of Haruun Kal]], where he led his [[Seven-One's regiment|regiment]] until his [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who was eventually designated CRC-09/571, also known simply as Seven-One, began his service with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[clone battalion commander]] within the [[airborne infantry]]. [[Seven-One's airborne group]] participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and led the frontal assault against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Core ship/Legends|core ships]]. Following the action on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], CRC-09/571 participated in the [[Battle of Teyr]],<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> as part of a [[Seven-One's battalion|battalion]] of the [[416th Star Corps]].<ref name="Mace Windu">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref>

CRC-09/571 was then promoted to [[clone regimental commander]] and, along with his [[Seven-One's regiment|regiment]], participated in the [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|Battle of Haruun Kal]] in an attempt to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. CRC-09/571 was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Kar Vastor]] when he took over the former [[Balawai]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] control center in an effort to level [[Pelek Baw/Legends|Pelek Baw]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" />
